WF-001.summary: Finds opportunities whose close date has already slipped past, so nothing sits forgotten in your pipeline.
WF-001.reads: Your opportunities with a close date on or before the staleness cutoff (30 days before today by default).
WF-001.useIt: Re-date, re-qualify, or close out each opportunity so your forecast reflects reality.

WF-002.summary: Lists engagement milestones that are past their target date and still not completed.
WF-002.reads: Milestones on your opportunities with a target date on or before today and a status other than Completed.
WF-002.useIt: Work the overdue list: complete, re-date, or escalate each milestone with its owner.

WF-003.summary: Flags opportunities where the recorded sales stage is not backed by milestone evidence.
WF-003.reads: Open, past-due milestones on your opportunities, compared against the stage each opportunity claims.
WF-003.useIt: Either capture the missing evidence or correct the stage before it reaches a forecast review.

WF-004.summary: Highlights opportunities that have no stakeholder or deal-team mapping recorded.
WF-004.reads: Your opportunities, checking which ones lack recorded stakeholder coverage.
WF-004.useIt: Map the economic buyer, technical decision maker, and champion before the next customer conversation.

WF-005.summary: The exception list a manager reviews each week: milestones explicitly marked At Risk or Blocked.
WF-005.reads: Past-due milestones on your opportunities whose status is At Risk or Blocked.
WF-005.useIt: Bring these to weekly governance with an owner and unblock date for each.

WF-006.summary: Surfaces opportunities where the committed forecast conflicts with the underlying deal signals.
WF-006.reads: Your opportunities ordered by close date, reconciled against the MSX forecast snapshot when available.
WF-006.useIt: Resolve each conflict before forecast submission so commit numbers hold up.

WF-007.summary: Builds a prep pack of everything scheduled with your customers in the coming weeks.
WF-007.reads: Activities on your opportunities due between today and the end of the meeting window (14 days by default).
WF-007.useIt: Walk into each meeting knowing the open threads, owners, and commitments attached to it.

WF-008.summary: Measures how much of your pipeline depends on a single account.
WF-008.reads: All of your opportunities, aggregated by account to compute the top account's share of pipeline.
WF-008.useIt: If one account dominates, diversify coverage or plan explicitly for the concentration risk.

WF-009.summary: Compares how opportunities are distributed across owners on your team.
WF-009.reads: Your opportunities grouped by owner and close date.
WF-009.useIt: Rebalance ownership where one seller is carrying a disproportionate share of the load.

WF-010.summary: Finds customer follow-ups you committed to but never closed out.
WF-010.reads: Activities on your opportunities that are past the follow-up threshold (14 days by default) and still not Completed.
WF-010.useIt: Close the loop with the customer, then complete or reschedule the activity.

WF-011.summary: Groups your opportunities by account to expose deals that depend on each other.
WF-011.reads: Your opportunities ordered by account and close date.
WF-011.useIt: Sequence dependent deals so an early slip does not cascade through the account.

WF-012.summary: Assembles the milestone evidence needed to defend a stage exit.
WF-012.reads: All milestones on your opportunities with a target date on or before today, regardless of status.
WF-012.useIt: Attach the packet to your stage-exit review so the decision is evidence-based.
